g.text: Defines a class which knows how to encode a kernel shader given buffers and dispatch threads
Has a corresponding factory class (ComputeKernelCreatable) which instanciates the class
Is an ObservableResult which ResultObservers can subscribe to, to get the resulting value after running on device
Defines a factory class for a corresponding ComputeKernel,
Responsible for allocating buffer memory on device based on parameters given
runCompute(from context : MetalComputeContext, for kernels : [ComputeKernel]) : Void «async» «throws»
buffer(for bufable: any MTBufable, device: MTLDevice) : MTLBuffer «async» «throws»
Used to store created MTLBuffers that are already in GPU memory which other objects may re-use
Wraps an MTLBuffer that already lives on the device; toMTLBuffer returns it with no copy.
Lets a kernel's output be fed straight into the next kernel as its input, so intermediate results
stay resident on the GPU instead of being downloaded to a [Float] and re-uploaded every stage.
Array-producing kernels (e.g. GrayScaleConvert, Subtraction) publish a DeviceBuffer to observers
Computes every pairwise dot product in a single dispatch (one threadgroup per pair, no atomics),
replacing N*(N+1)/2 separate DotProduct kernels. Publishes one [Float] of results to observers
2-D DCT of 32x32 images via a precomputed 8x32 basis (two separable matrix passes,
one threadgroup per image). Backs the perceptual hash (ImageHash) -- publishes an [Float]
of 8x8 low-frequency coefficients per image to observers
